name: Swarnim S Chavan
player_statement:
A complete player, Swarnim S Chavan has made a big mark in cricket. With 13 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 30, with an average of 11.86 and a quick strike rate of 105.06. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 7 sixes and 3 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 13.0 overs, taking 7 wickets at an economy rate of 7.54. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
